title: Declare the Cargo workspace resolver
why: A virtual workspace cannot infer its dependency resolver from a root package edition and may retain resolver behavior older than its members expect.
suggestion: Set workspace.resolver to 2 for edition 2021 members or 3 for edition 2024 members.
limitations: Only virtual workspaces with an edition 2021 or newer production member are reported.
Code Buster recommends the resolver associated with the newest declared member or workspace package edition.
